scientific_scope: observation-deletion structured-variance q=1 firm-target convergence diagnosis
interpretation: Assumption-conditional evidence for FEVC's common structured variance models, not unrestricted-heteroskedastic KSS variance products.

factorized_oracle.conditional_covariance: exact factorized trace, not randomized trace probes

classification.finite_sample_convergence: oracle and fitted paths pass every existing gate at k=32,48,64
classification.q1_reference_or_remainder_problem: oracle fails at k=48 or k=64 while concentration diagnostics improve
classification.ambiguous: any other outcome withholds promotion and does not authorize an unregistered larger run
classification.forbidden_response: no post-result threshold change, empirical calibration factor, target exclusion, or automatic dimension extension

confirmation.registration_condition: implemented source and harness pass development diagnostics and are committed before manifest creation
confirmation.legacy_matrix: rerun the V1 confirmation matrix at its registered dimensions and replication counts; retain the two k=16 firm failures as named finite-sample diagnostics
confirmation.promotion_rule: all V2 gates pass; q=0 and q=1 promote together
